headline: Julius Baer India appoints Jayesh Kothari as CHRO
summary: Julius Baer India has appointed Jayesh Kothari as Managing Director, Senior Advisor, and Chief Human Resource Officer to support its expansion and talent development in the country. Kothari brings over 25 years of HR leadership experience across wealth and investment banking, having spent the last 11 years at Barclays. His focus will include expanding the firm's relationship manager base, strengthening mid-office functions, and building internal leadership depth.

headline: When the rulebook runs out, culture takes over: Sanjay Bose
summary: Sanjay Bose, EVP and Head of HR at ITC Hotels, highlighted that organizational culture serves as a critical business differentiator when standard procedures cannot cover every customer interaction. Speaking at an HRKatha event, Bose explained that leadership actions directly shape the adaptive behaviors employees rely on during unscripted moments. The discussion also explored whether organizational culture can be scientifically measured to link everyday employee behavior directly to business performance.

headline: Coca-Cola elevates Rishav Gandhi as VP, people & culture for Eurasia and Middle East
summary: The Coca-Cola Company has appointed Rishav Gandhi as Vice President of People & Culture for the Eurasia and Middle East region, an on-site role based in Türkiye effective August 2026. Gandhi has been with Coca-Cola for nearly eight years, previously leading people strategy for global marketing, the McDonald's Division, and Latin America. His professional background also includes human capital consulting at Deloitte US and HR leadership roles at Airtel.

headline: POV: Should employees be encouraged to build personal brands alongside company roles?
summary: Business leaders suggest that organizations should encourage employees to build personal brands, provided clear governance frameworks and boundaries are established. While personal visibility can boost individual credibility and employer brand reach, companies must carefully manage risks related to confidentiality and reputational alignment. Striking the right balance allows workers to share professional knowledge while protecting corporate interests.

headline: Apple trims jobs amid cost pressures
summary: Apple has executed a second round of job cuts in under two months, targeting its Fitness+ team to reduce operational costs and slow down audio content releases. This follows a larger layoff in August that eliminated over 200 roles across Siri, Vision Pro, and AI engineering units. The structural changes reflect the company's broader effort to balance innovation with financial discipline amid shifting strategic priorities.

headline: Selvi Supuriamaniam’s role expanded to HR director-India, Stanley Black & Decker
summary: Selvi Supuriamaniam, currently serving as HR Director for the Middle East and East-West Africa at Stanley Black & Decker, has expanded her portfolio to also lead HR operations in India. She joined the company in 2024 following extensive human resources leadership experience at major global firms, including General Mills, Baxter International, and Coca-Cola. In her enlarged role, she will oversee talent management across India in addition to her existing regional markets.
